taxonomy.problem: Intermittent lease-renewal oscillation causing bursts of NLX-4207 lease renewal timeouts and NLX-4210 stale primary errors, elevating p99 write latency and queuing writes up to ~30s.
taxonomy.node_label: Lease-renewal oscillation causing timeouts and stale primaries

taxonomy.description:
What: Opens the Nimbus Ledger platform-wide regional health dashboard URL.
Why: First-line triage used it to check whether other regions/teams were seeing correlated issues alongside NLX-4207 bursts.
Purpose: Determine if the incident was platform-wide/regional or isolated to their service/region.
Expected outcome: Evidence of broader regional degradation or correlated signals in other regions.
Actual findings/conclusions: The text states “Nothing anomalous outside our own NLX-4207 trace,” indicating no broader correlated anomaly.
Impact on troubleshooting: Helped rule out a wider platform/regional incident and focus investigation on their own component/path.
taxonomy.possible_outcome: Platform-wide regional health view shows nothing anomalous outside the incident’s own NLX-4207 trace; no broader correlated issues detected.

taxonomy.raw_action_string: nl_incident_events | where TIMESTAMP > ago(24h) | summarize count() by region, err_code
taxonomy.description:
What: AQL query over `nl_incident_events` filtering to the last 24 hours and summarizing counts by `region` and `err_code`.
Why: Ran as a cross-region/cross-team correlation check after seeing NLX-4207 bursts.
Purpose: Identify whether NLX-4207 (or other error codes) were occurring broadly across regions, suggesting a systemic issue.
Expected outcome: A breakdown showing multiple regions/teams impacted if there was a widespread problem.
Actual findings/conclusions: “only our own err_code shows up in the top-10. no cross-team correlation.”
Impact on troubleshooting: Supported the conclusion that the issue was localized rather than a platform-wide correlated event.
taxonomy.trigger_observation: Platform-wide regional health view shows nothing anomalous outside the incident’s own NLX-4207 trace; no broader correlated issues detected.
taxonomy.possible_outcome: Cross-region incident-events query shows only this incident’s error code in the top results; no cross-team/cross-service correlation found.
taxonomy.node_label: Query incident events for cross-region correlation

taxonomy.raw_action_string: nl_lease_events | where err_code == 'NLX-4207' | where TIMESTAMP > ago(24h) | summarize count() by region
taxonomy.description:
What: AQL query over `nl_lease_events` filtering to `err_code == 'NLX-4207'` and last 24 hours, then summarizing counts by `region`.
Why: Performed a quick pull to quantify and compare NLX-4207 incidence across regions after discussion about thresholds/offsets and to see which regions were clean.
Purpose: Identify regional distribution and highlight anomalies (e.g., why eastus is clean) to guide hypotheses (build differences, load differences, etc.).
Expected outcome: Counts per region showing where NLX-4207 is occurring.
Actual findings/conclusions: Reported results: westus 4102, northeu 3980, eastus 0, southasia 12; concluded eastus is completely clean and asked what differs about eastus.
Impact on troubleshooting: Narrowed investigation by identifying eastus as a control region (no errors), enabling follow-up hypotheses around build/version or traffic/load differences.

AQL literal values in predicates/filters: 'NLX-4207', ago(24h). No literal values were stated as discovered by prior actions (the error code is part of the incident context), so no hard dependency is established.
taxonomy.trigger_observation: Cross-region incident-events query shows only this incident’s error code in the top results; no cross-team/cross-service correlation found.
taxonomy.possible_outcome: NLX-4207 events are concentrated in westus and northeu (thousands) while eastus shows zero, indicating a region-specific difference rather than uniform global behavior.
taxonomy.node_label: Compare NLX-4207 lease errors by region

taxonomy.description:
What: Opens the Nimbus Ledger incident dashboard for incident 999000001.
Why/Purpose: The summary states metrics were pulled from the "nl_lease_events dashboard" and lists dashboards touched; this link is part of the investigation tooling used to view incident-specific telemetry.
Expected outcome: View incident timeline/metrics (e.g., NLX-4207 rates) to understand impact and progression.
Actual findings/conclusions: The narrative indicates NLX-4207 bursts occurred in westus/northeu and eastus behavior differed until build alignment; the dashboard was a source for those referenced metrics.
Impact on troubleshooting: Supported data-driven validation of hypotheses (e.g., canary effect, region comparisons) and confirmation of mitigation after 9901 rollout.
taxonomy.trigger_observation: NLX-4207 events are concentrated in westus and northeu (thousands) while eastus shows zero, indicating a region-specific difference rather than uniform global behavior.
taxonomy.node_label: Review incident dashboard timeline and metrics

taxonomy.description:
What: Opens a lease oscillation detail dashboard.
Why/Purpose: Used during investigation of "recurring lease-renewal oscillation" / NLX-4207 bursts to drill into detailed oscillation signals beyond the high-level incident view.
Expected outcome: Identify patterns/correlations (timing, regions, renewal behavior) that could explain NLX-4207 spikes.
Actual findings/conclusions: The write-up concludes a write-coordinator build regression (8901) caused reordering under contention for primary regions; this dashboard likely helped validate oscillation shape across regions.
Impact on troubleshooting: Enabled deeper inspection of the oscillation phenomenon to support root-cause isolation and validate mitigation effectiveness.

What: Opens a dashboard focused on southasia placement drift.
Why/Purpose: The summary states southasia remained elevated with a different failure mode correlated with shard placement drift; this dashboard is a targeted tool to investigate that residual issue.
Expected outcome: Visualize/confirm placement drift signals in southasia and correlate them with the low-rate NLX-4207 stream.
Actual findings/conclusions: The narrative concludes southasia is a separate failure mode (placement-service problem) distinct from the 8901/9901 write-coordinator regression.
Impact on troubleshooting: Helped separate the incident into two causes and justified splitting southasia residual into a separate work item for placement-service RCA.
taxonomy.node_label: Investigate southasia shard placement drift dashboard

taxonomy.resolution: Write-coordinator fix build 9901 (targeted revert of the 8901 renewal-ack reordering change) rolled out overnight; NLX-4207 dropped to baseline in westus/eastus/northeu within ~20 minutes.
taxonomy.node_label: Roll out write-coordinator revert build to stabilize
